questions.question: Which launch angle usually gives the greatest range on level ground?
questions.explanation: On level ground without air resistance, 45° balances vertical and horizontal components for maximum range.

questions.question: What force pulls a projectile downward after release?
Increasing launch speed can increase projectile range.
questions.explanation: More speed gives the projectile more horizontal motion and often more time aloft.

questions.question: A projectile must have a continuous forward force to keep moving forward.
questions.explanation: After release, inertia keeps horizontal motion while gravity acts vertically.

questions.question: The horizontal distance traveled by a projectile is called its ________.
questions.explanation: Range is the horizontal distance from launch to landing.

questions.question: Explain why a basketball shot follows a curved path.
questions.correctAnswer: A good answer mentions forward motion plus downward acceleration due to gravity.
questions.explanation: The ball keeps moving forward while gravity pulls it downward, making an arc.
